errors.evidence: The plot shows four data series (lines) representing four different conditions, as indicated by the legend. The description only mentions three, omitting the "Consistency-CE" series entirely.

errors.evidence: The red line labeled "Consistency-Bi" does not start at an Average Lagging (AL) value of 2.5. Its first data point is located at approximately AL 4.1 with a BLEU score of about 30.3.

The description states the "Inconsistency-CE" line ends at AL 10.0. However, the plot shows this data point is clearly to the right of the 10.0 tick mark, at an approximate AL of 10.4. The description systematically misreports the x-coordinates of data points as aligning with the tick marks.
The final data point for the "Consistency-Bi" line is at a BLEU score of approximately 33.0, not 33.4. The reported value is noticeably higher than what is shown on the plot.
